issue:
Broken URL in deprecation warning for job working directory changes

Description

I noticed that when running an application that doesn't specify the `_chdir` parameter, the deprecation warning shows a URL that returns a 404 error.

The URL in the warning message is:
https://hydra.cc/docs/1.2/upgrades/1.1_to_1.2/changes_to_job_working_dir/

When trying to access this URL, it fails with a 404 error. The correct URL should be:
https://hydra.cc/docs/upgrades/1.1_to_1.2/changes_to_job_working_dir

To reproduce:
1. Create a simple Hydra app that doesn't specify the `_chdir` parameter in the `@hydra.main` decorator
2. Run the app
3. Observe the deprecation warning with the incorrect URL

This is problematic because users trying to understand the upcoming changes to job working directory behavior can't access the documentation referenced in the warning.

actions.old_string:
if _chdir is None:
            url = "https://hydra.cc/docs/1.2/upgrades/1.1_to_1.2/changes_to_job_working_dir/"
            deprecation_warning(
                message=dedent(
                    f"""\
                    Future Hydra versions will no longer change working directory at job runtime by default.
                    See {url} for more information."""
                ),
                stacklevel=2,
            )
            _chdir = True
